user_evidence: LIS3MDL board X direction faces the GNSS receiver board
Parent calibration forward is GNSS receiver toward Spresense
Estimate magnetic heading without requiring accuracy validation

basis.mag_z: +CAD Z: assume component/silkscreen side up as CAD
basis.nominal_axis_assumption: Directions select orthogonal assembly axes, not exact lines between board centers. No measured in-plane mounting angle is available.
basis.vendor_board_axes: +sensor X=+EAGLE Y, +sensor Y=-EAGLE X, +sensor Z=board top normal
basis.cad_orientation_override: CAD Rz(90) composed with silkscreen axes would give sensor +X=-CAD X. User mounting takes precedence: use 180 degree in-plane reversal of the modeled board orientation. CAD positions are not changed.

magnetic_input: logged corrected_x/y/z in microtesla, calibration_generation=1; no second bias correction
camera_mount: R_frd_from_spresense from axis011 composed with inverse of Oct28 run-specific R_camera_imu
tilt_policy: Oct28 camera quaternion SLERP within 0.1s brackets; otherwise corrected Spresense accelerometer tilt within 0.1s brackets. No gap extrapolation.
